name: Hawaii 4-H Youth Development
org: University of Hawaii at Manoa CTAHR Cooperative Extension Service
city: Oahu, Maui, Kauai and Hawaii Island
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or a special interest program. Do hands-on projects like gardening, animals, robots, public speaking or woodworking. Teens build leadership and life skills.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 5 to 19. On Oahu, fill out the Oahu County 4-H Interest Form to join a club or program.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program pages.
deadline_text: Oahu's 2026-27 4-H program year enrollment starts September 1, 2026.
how_to_apply: On Oahu, fill out the Oahu County 4-H Interest Form. On other islands, use the Contact page on the Hawaii 4-H site to find your county program. Email Christine at chanakaw@hawaii.edu with Oahu questions.
notes: About 4,000 youth take part each year across the state. Meetings can be in homes, schools or community buildings. Oahu also lists day camps, shooting sports and a garden center program.
